title: TACS-RF: Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave Modules
abstract: arXiv:2610.31882v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present the framework of TACS-RF - a Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave modules. In this framework, a large-language-model (LLM) coding agent (Claude Opus 4.8) directly drives industry-standard electronic-design-automation (EDA) tools such as Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Calibre, Cadence EMX, and Ansys HFSS to design RF and mmWave modules. We validate the framework through the agentic design of a 240-251 GHz sub-THz transmitter in a 90 nm SiGe BiCMOS process. The agent semi-autonomously designed the sub-blocks including a 60 GHz push-push Colpitts VCO with second-harmonic extraction, multistage differential cascode power drivers, a push-push frequency doubler, a differential bowtie antenna, and all the interstage matching networks. The transmitter chain with parasitic-extracted devices and EM-verified passives delivers +5.1 to +6.3 dBm across an 11 GHz varactor-only tuning range, phase noise of -80 to -88 dBc/Hz at 1

translated_title: TACS-RF：工具驱动的射频与毫米波模块智能体电路综合
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TACS-RF框架——一种工具驱动的射频与毫米波模块智能体电路综合方法。在该框架中，大语言模型（LLM）编程智能体直接驱动业界标准的电子设计自动化（EDA）工具，如Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre、Calibre、Cadence EMX和Ansys HFSS，来设计射频与毫米波模块。我们通过在90nm SiGe BiCMOS工艺下设计一个240-251GHz亚太赫兹发射机来验证该框架。该智能体半自主地设计了各个子模块，包括一个带二次谐波提取的60GHz推推式Colpitts压控振荡器（VCO）、多级差分共源共栅功率驱动器、一个推推式倍频器、一个差分蝶形天线以及全部级间匹配网络。包含寄生参数提取器件和经电磁验证无源器件的发射机链，在11GHz的纯变容管调谐范围内提供+5.1至+6.3dBm的输出功率，1MHz频偏处相位噪声为-80至-88dBc/Hz（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了TACS-RF框架，首次让LLM编程智能体直接驱动Cadence、Ansys等工业级EDA工具，半自主完成了90nm SiGe BiCMOS工艺下240-251GHz亚太赫兹发射机从振荡器、功率驱动、倍频器到天线的完整芯片设计，验证了LLM智能体驱动真实射频芯片设计流程的可行性。
en_tdlr: TACS-RF is a tool-driven agentic framework in which an LLM coding agent directly drives industry-standard EDA tools to semi-autonomously design a complete 240-251 GHz sub-THz transmitter in 90 nm SiGe BiCMOS, demonstrating the feasibility of LLM-agent-driven industrial RF chip design.
